title: Pin each exclusion of the mailbox-only bind-retry predicate
outcome: Meaningful negative controls keep each mailbox-only admission-recovery exclusion fail-closed, including actual mailbox-source delegation work.
acceptance: A table-driven fixture starts with an otherwise eligible Mailbox-source head and varies each independent exclusion (attachments or expanded text, delegation associations, recovered admission, grants/evaluate, source-observation, durability and cleanup holds), asserting no automatic bind retry and retained work.
Mailbox-source delegation followup is covered directly; User-source early rejection is not used as evidence for the delegation exclusions.
Credited focused tests pass and the independent review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
